Passports
The Register of Deeds’s office accepts passport applications Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.
Protect Yourself from Passport Scams
Do not use third-party websites to apply for your passport. Passport applications are available through the Mackinac County Register of Deeds office or The Department of State .
The Department of State website provides application information, forms and up to date processing times.
Visit The Department of State Passport Website
THE FOLLOWING DOCUMENTS ARE REQUIRED WHEN APPLYING FOR A U.S. PASSPORT BOOK OR CARD:
Proof of Citizenship: Certified copy of birth certificate or naturalization certificate.
Picture Identification: Such as valid driver’s license, military identification or passport.
One Passport Quality Photograph: 2”x2” in size with a white background. ***The Mackinac County Register of Deeds Office will take passport photos for a charge of $10.00***
The Mackinac County Register of Deed’s Office will process your application Monday thru Friday, 8:30a.m. to 3:30p.m. (906) 643-7306 ***PARTIES OF 3 OR MORE MUST SCHEDULE AN APPOINTMENT***
Passport Book:
Adult: $130.00 check or money order made payable to the U.S. Department of State
Child: (Age 15 and under) $100.00 check or money order made payable to the Department of State. ***All minor children and parent(s) listed on birth record, MUST be present at the time of application***
Passport Card:
Adult: $30.00 check or money order made payable to the U.S. Department of State
Child: (Age 15 and under) $15.00 check or money order made payable to the U.S. Department of State ***All minor children and parent(s) listed on birth record, MUST be present at the time of application***
Both Passport Book & Passport Card:
Adult: $160.00 check or money order made payable to the U.S. Department of State
Child: (Age 15 and under) $115.00 check or money order made payable to the U.S. Department of State ***All minor children and parent(s) listed on birth record, MUST be present at the time of application***
Expedite Fee:
To expedite, add an additional $60.00 fee made payable to the U.S. Department of State
Register of Deeds Fee:
$35.00 CASH OR CHECK MADE PAYABLE TO THE MACKINAC COUNTY REGISTER OF DEEDS FOR THE PROCESSING FEE, IF PICTURE IS NEEDED ADD AN ADDITIONAL $10.00
